title: Create the private ECR OCI GitOps foundation
expected_outcome: Private ECR OCI repositories and a least-privilege GitHub OIDC identity permit a digest-reviewed workflow to mirror deployment artifacts without Vault credentials, NAT, public listeners, or mutable deployment tags.
constraints: No Vault initialization, unseal, secret material, public endpoints, workload deployment, or release-signing activation.
Every mirrored OCI artifact is supplied and verified by sha256 digest; no mutable deployment tag is accepted.

external_actions: create and update approved ECR and IAM foundation resources
create protected GitHub Environment configuration containing non-secret bootstrap values

delegations.scope: clean-room review of task bundle, relevant diff, and checks only
delegations.escalation: report any unsafe trust, authorization, digest, or validation gap
